slides.title: How to set up a quiet time you won't skip:
Same place, same time
paras: Pick one table and one time and protect it.
Lay it out tonight: Bible open, pen on top, phone charging in another room. When you wake up, the decision is already made.

slides.title: Open the Word first
paras: Before the news. Before the group chat.
“My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up.” Psalm 5:3

slides.title: Read with a pen
paras: Don't just read it, wrestle with it.
Write one verse you want to remember and one thing you'll do about it today. One line is enough. Over a year, that's a whole notebook of what God taught you.

slides.title: Keep it small
paras: Ten honest minutes beats an hour you never start.
Don't stack five devotionals on day one. Pick one plan, finish it, and let the habit grow before the time does.
